toegepas.voor: baie eienskappe wys op iets wat ons daarvan maak
toegepas.na: baie van sy eienskappe pas by iets wat ons daarvan maak
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Eienskappe wys op iets wat ons maak' is vague and wooden; 'pas by' says plainly that a property suits a use, and 'baie' is kept.
toegepas.fout: 'eienskappe wys op iets wat ons daarvan maak' is vague and wooden; properties do not 'point to' an object
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'pas by' says plainly that a property suits a use, keeps 'baie' and adds no fact.

toegepas.voor: Baie metale is hard en sterk en mense
toegepas.na: Baie metale is hard en sterk, en mense
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma between two clauses with their own subject and verb; the run of 'en ... en' makes a reader stumble
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both halves are full clauses, so the AWS comma is required and also separates the list 'hard en sterk' from the clause join.

toegepas.voor: Die metaal is nie werklik kouer nie en die verskil
toegepas.na: Die metaal is nie werklik kouer nie, en die verskil
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma between two full clauses
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die metaal is nie ... nie' and 'die verskil sit ...' each have their own subject and verb.

toegepas.voor: Jou hand voel daardie hitte weggaan en noem dit koud
toegepas.na: Jou hand voel hoe daardie hitte weggaan, en jy noem dit koud
toegepas.rede_vinder: A hand cannot 'name' something, so the subject of 'noem' should be 'jy'; 'voel hoe' is the natural construction, and the comma follows the AWS; 'hitte' is kept.
toegepas.fout: a hand cannot name something; 'voel daardie hitte weggaan' is a stiff construction
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'voel hoe ... weggaan' is the natural construction and 'jy noem dit koud' gives 'noem' a proper subject; the heat flow, its direction and 'hitte' are unchanged.

toegepas.voor: Koue kom nie by jou hand in nie en net hitte beweeg
toegepas.na: Koue kom nie by jou hand in nie, en net hitte beweeg
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma between two full clauses
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Koue kom nie ... nie' and 'net hitte beweeg' each have their own subject and verb.

toegepas.voor: Party vlekvrye staal word glad nie
toegepas.na: Party soorte vlekvrye staal word glad nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Party' with an uncountable material reads awkwardly; 'party soorte' is natural and keeps the meaning.
toegepas.fout: 'party' with an uncountable material reads awkwardly
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'party soorte vlekvrye staal' is natural and states the same claim, since it is the kind of stainless steel that decides whether a magnet attracts it.

toegepas.voor: Koper en aluminium word nie aangetrek nie en goud en silwer ook nie
toegepas.na: Koper, aluminium, goud en silwer word nie aangetrek nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: The trailing 'en goud en silwer ook nie' stacks three 'en's; one list says the same thing more clearly.
toegepas.fout: three stacked 'en's in one sentence read clumsily
toegepas.rede_keurder: One list says exactly the same four metals are not attracted, more clearly and in fewer words.

toegepas.voor: aangetrek word, en nie watter metaal
toegepas.na: aangetrek word en nie watter metaal
toegepas.rede_vinder: The part after 'en' has no subject and verb of its own, so the AWS puts no comma before it.
toegepas.fout: comma before 'en' where the second part is elliptical and has no subject and verb of its own
toegepas.rede_keurder: Under the AWS rule the house follows, no comma goes before 'en' between parts of one sentence; the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: Los 'n stuk yster in die reën en 'n rooibruin
toegepas.na: Los 'n stuk yster in die reën, en 'n rooibruin
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two main clauses.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma between two main clauses; without it 'die reën en 'n rooibruin laag' can be misread as one phrase
toegepas.rede_keurder: The imperative clause and 'n rooibruin laag vorm' are two full clauses, and the comma prevents a stumble.

toegepas.voor: Droë yster in 'n kas roes nie en yster
toegepas.na: Droë yster in 'n kas roes nie, en yster
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma between two full clauses
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Droë yster ... roes nie' and 'yster onder water ... roes ook nie' each have their own subject and verb.

toegepas.voor: Staal word van yster gemaak en 'n staalhek
toegepas.na: Staal word van yster gemaak, en 'n staalhek
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma between two full clauses
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Staal word ... gemaak' and 'n staalhek roes' each have their own subject and verb.

toegepas.voor: Roes skilfer af en dan roes
toegepas.na: Roes skilfer af, en dan roes
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma between two full clauses
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Roes skilfer af' and 'dan roes die yster daaronder ook' each have their own subject and verb.

toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma between two full clauses
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Verf lê bo-op' and 'n krap laat ... roes' each have their own subject and verb.

toegepas.blok: Metale wat vlek en metale wat blink bly
toegepas.voor: Silwer word met tyd donker van sekere gasse
toegepas.na: Silwer word mettertyd donker deur sekere gasse
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Met tyd' is a calque of 'with time'; Afrikaans says 'mettertyd', and 'deur' names the cause more clearly than 'van'.
toegepas.fout: 'met tyd' is a calque of 'with time'; Afrikaans says 'mettertyd'
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'mettertyd' fixes the calque, and 'deur' still names the gases as the cause of the darkening, so who does what is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: goud bly blink en silwer word net dof
toegepas.na: goud bly blink, en silwer word net dof
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma between two clauses with their own subject and verb
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'goud bly blink' and 'silwer word net dof' are two full clauses.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Afrikaans speaks of 'swaar gewig', not 'groot gewig'.
toegepas.fout: 'groot gewig dra' leans towards the figurative idiom 'to carry great weight' (to be important)
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'swaar gewig' is the natural literal collocation and keeps the meaning that steel bears heavy loads.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Verslyt' is the usual standard form for wearing away; 'slyt' reads dated.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'slyt' is current standard Afrikaans alongside 'verslyt', so this is a lateral swap.

laat_vaar.na: wanneer lug en water daarby uitkom
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Bykom' alone is vague; 'daarby uitkom' matches the study text's 'by die yster uitkom' and is clearer for Grade 5.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: This rewords a glossary definition, and 'wanneer lug en water bykom' is already idiomatic Afrikaans for air and water reaching the iron.

na_skrywer.voor: metaal met tyd donker en dof
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Met tyd' is a calque of 'with time'; Afrikaans says 'mettertyd'.
na_skrywer.fout: 'met tyd' is a calque of 'with time'; Afrikaans says 'mettertyd'
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but it sits in the glossary definition of 'vlek', which may be shared word for word across lessons and changes only through the writer.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.blok: Metale wat vlek en metale wat blink bly
vlae.teks: Net yster roes, maar lug en water verander ook baie ander metale.
vlae.rede: Read alone, 'Net yster roes' seems to leave out steel, which the previous block says rusts too; the earlier block explains steel is made from iron, so this is probably fine, but the writer may want to check that a learner cannot read it as a contradiction. Not changed because it touches content.
